description: This file is a test class for the EmployeeAllowedReportToEmployeeAPI endpoint in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for various methods of the API, including retrieving subordinate and supervisor lists, and validating inputs. The class is part of the test suite for the Pim module, specifically for API version 2.
